notes.title: FAQ and BETA TEST
notes.notes:
Hello, Game is almost finished if I could able to finish remaining things like translation and controls in time. The game will release next week.
Also, I'm planning to start the beta on Sunday, If you're interested please join discord server. I will post a link there.
[url=https://discord.com/invite/HGx6Q7f]DISCORD SERVER[/url]

FAQ
1) What is Pizza shop manager.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39593203/269f3271e429f20337644b6ef6a9c33ada4d7a1c.png[/img]
I always wanted to make a tycoon game with RPG/Simulator element. In the game, Player manages his pizza shop. My main aim is to bring economic challenges of tycoon game with the freedom offered by simulator games.

2) Can we make our own pizza
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39593203/abdea2f50f9d1da18841bb01c6b96e0639ca7f53.png[/img]
Yes!!
As an owner of Pizza shop, you need to set the menu of your shop. While making sure you are satisfying your customers. Making pizza is easy. Based upon the recipe of pizza select ingredient from makeline(pizza counter with all ingredients in it). Then Use the oven to bake pizza and serve.

3) Online Orders?
Yes, Online order of pizza is available. Player can unlock it at a later stage of the game.

4)Custom Order?
Customer will choose the ingredients of their pizza. Player can unlock it at a later stage.

5)What are my duties as a manager?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39593203/222a53d936e3e8bf320628998e07a2e60087aa29.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39593203/be3f40485b8e6c0eb7711a69ed468474aecbdc10.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39593203/7749bc5c1251b31f9041f3b4ca5f598d6bc044d2.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39593203/708775db49793c9f3c0dc258d8bcff147bdb00e2.png[/img]
You set up menu, Order ingredients, Hire employees, Set their schedule. You can also help your employees to make pizza.

6) What customization options are available?
Wide range of furniture types is available to buy and place in your shop. Also, you can paint the wall add posters to it. Player can also import custom image inside a game to put up as a poster.
